title: Website Terms of Use in Fort Myers | Riverside Family Eye Care
metaDescription: Website terms of use for Riverside Family Eye Care in Fort Myers: how this site may be used, links, liability and updates.
html:
Riverside Family Eye Care, Fort Myers, FL. These terms cover how this website may be used. They are about the website itself, not about your care — care is covered by our disclaimer and by what our doctors discuss with you in person.

Effective date: August 2026

Placeholder — not yet reviewed. This page is generic placeholder wording, put in place so the site has a terms page. It has not been written or reviewed by an attorney and it is not tailored to this practice. Replace it with counsel-approved terms before this site is published or relied upon.

About these terms

These terms apply to your use of this website. By browsing the site you accept them. If you do not accept them, please do not use the site.

They cover the website only. They do not describe the care you receive as a patient, and they do not change anything our doctors tell you during an exam.

Using this website

You are welcome to read this site, print pages for your own reference, and share links to it. Please do not attempt to disrupt the site, reach parts of it that are not public, scrape it at scale, or use it in a way that breaks the law or interferes with anyone else using it.

Appointment requests & messages

Any appointment request or message you send through this site is a request, not a confirmed booking. An appointment is confirmed only when the practice confirms it with you directly.

Please do not send urgent or emergency information through this website. If you are having an eye emergency, call the office at 239-500-2020 during opening hours, or seek in-person care right away. In a life-threatening emergency, call 911.

Please also avoid sending sensitive medical detail through a web form. If we need that information, we will collect it properly, in person or by a secure route.

Content & ownership

The text, images, layout and branding on this site belong to the practice or are used with permission. Please do not republish them commercially, or present them as your own, without asking us first.

Brand names and logos of frame and lens manufacturers shown on this site belong to their respective owners and appear only to describe the products we carry.

Links to other sites

This site may link to other websites. Those links are offered as a convenience. We do not control that content, we do not endorse it, and we cannot be responsible for it. Following an external link is at your own discretion.

No warranties

We work to keep this site accurate, available and current, but we cannot promise it will always be error-free or uninterrupted. The site is provided on an as-is basis, and the information on it is general rather than specific to you.

Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows, the practice is not liable for loss arising from your use of this website, or from being unable to use it. Nothing in these terms limits any liability that cannot lawfully be limited, including anything relating to the care we actually provide to you as a patient.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. The version published on this page is the one that applies. If a change is significant, we will note it on this page.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida, and any dispute relating to this website will be handled in the courts serving Lee County, Florida.

Questions about these terms

Have a question about these terms, or want a copy for your records? Reach us at our Fort Myers office and we will be glad to help.
